Class TagField

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.subsystems.vision.TagField
public final class TagField extends Object
Which AprilTag field the robot solves with, as a logged input (Vision/FieldMap/Name and Hash). The Orin poses are solved on the robot from logged detections, so a replay re-solves them with whatever layout it loads: it must load the match's field, not whatever Event says today.

      public static TagField.Choice load(AprilTagFields eventField)
